mailbox_binding_hmac.input_layout: use exactly one ADR-005 digest_suite input envelope; exactly three ordered owning-ADR components: one-byte cloud code 1 for commercial_global_work_school, 16-byte RFC4122 network-order tid claim UUID, and 16-byte RFC4122 network-order oid claim UUID; never repeat the purpose account binding schema version or component count

observation_digest_contract.observed_version_v1: ordered components: 32-byte source_version_hmac; parentFolderId exact UTF-8 bytes; u8 direction code; u8 read-observation code; u8 first-observation code; RFC3339-seconds-Z observed-at ASCII bytes; u32be policy version
observation_digest_contract.transient_inputs: immutable id changeKey parentFolderId and query strings are never separately persisted logged diagnosed exported or packaged

sanitize HTML to inert text with no scripts styles remote resources active schemes or hidden executable content

split into the component-specific ordered block list and build a transient source offset map
canonical_anchor_contract.range_unit: zero-based Unicode scalar index in one NFC canonical block
canonical_anchor_contract.context_edges: use the available zero-to-64 scalars immediately before or after the range in the same block; never cross a block boundary
canonical_anchor_contract.digest_key: distinct random per-account content-digest key owned by ADR-005
canonical_anchor_contract.framing: use exactly one ADR-005 digest_suite input envelope; the first six ordered owning-ADR components are 16-byte source_ref_id, four-byte u32be component code from component_code_map, four-byte u32be block_ordinal, four-byte u32be range_start, four-byte u32be range_end, and four-byte u32be anchor_version; the seventh component is purpose-specific exact NFC UTF-8 text as defined by purpose_layouts; every component is carried once by the ADR-005 u32be-length component framing and the purpose tag account binding schema version and component count are never repeated

purpose_layouts.seventh_component: exact canonical text from range_start inclusive to range_end exclusive
exact available zero-to-64-scalar canonical prefix immediately before range_start in the same block

canonical_anchor_contract.digest_non_authority: a digest match proves content equality under the key and framing; it never alone proves item identity ownership account folder or copy lineage

graph_shape_rules.subject: required JSON string with at most 1048576 Unicode scalars after validation
graph_shape_rules.body: required itemBody object projected to exactly contentType and content; contentType must equal lowercase html because the exact request preference asks for html and content must be a JSON string; any other missing duplicate null type or value rejects the item
graph_shape_rules.sender_and_from: each present value must project to exactly one recipient object; sender is used and from is fallback only when sender is absent
graph_shape_rules.to_and_cc: required JSON arrays in service order with at most 500 recipient objects each
graph_shape_rules.recipient: project exactly emailAddress.name and emailAddress.address as JSON strings; name may be empty, address must contain 1-to-1024 UTF-8 bytes, and unknown projected fields or invalid values reject
graph_shape_rules.attachments: for every accepted message, regardless of hasAttachments, page the exact graph_request_contract attachment endpoint and query to completion under the item/account binding; require at most 256 unique case-sensitive attachment ids, reject duplicate ids or incomplete/capped paging, sort the complete set by unsigned UTF-8 attachment-id bytes, use only name strings as blocks, and discard every attachment id after ordering; hasAttachments is never authoritative because inline-only attachments can leave it false
graph_shape_rules.odata_annotations: the transport may remove only schema-known OData annotation members before this projection; no ordinary unknown field is silently accepted
graph_shape_rules.invalid_shape_result: recoverable quarantine or analysis unavailable before anchor creation; zero cursor advance unless ADR-004 recoverability is durable

scalar_policy.json_decode: reject any unpaired UTF-16 surrogate before scalar conversion
scalar_policy.normalization: Unicode NFC after line-ending and HTML-text projection
scalar_policy.rejected_scalars: U+0000 through U+0008, U+000B, U+000C, U+000E through U+001F, U+007F through U+009F, U+FDD0 through U+FDEF, and every scalar ending FFFE or FFFF
scalar_policy.allowed_ascii_controls: HT and LF only before text whitespace normalization; CR is consumed by line-ending normalization
scalar_policy.comparison: case-sensitive Unicode scalar equality after NFC unless a field rule states otherwise

canonical_projection_contract.participant_text_rule: normalize line endings, reject forbidden scalars, replace every HT with one ASCII space, trim only leading/trailing ASCII spaces, NFC-normalize name and address independently, preserve address case, then emit address alone when name is empty or name plus one ASCII space plus less-than plus address plus greater-than

html_text_profile.parser: WHATWG HTML fragment parsing algorithm with a body context; no scripting flag and no network/resource loader; character references are decoded by the parser
html_text_profile.dom_event_algorithm: walk the accepted fragment DOM in depth-first tree order. An ignored node emits nothing. A drop element emits nothing and its descendants are not visited. For every block_boundary_element except an outermost blockquote segmentation boundary, emit exactly one LF immediately before visiting its first child and exactly one LF immediately after visiting its last child, including when it has no children. For every td or th, emit exactly one LF immediately before its first child and one LF immediately after its last child. For br or hr emit exactly one LF and visit no children. Every other accepted element emits no entry or exit character and visits children in tree order. Each accepted text node emits its complete parser-decoded scalar sequence after the text-node whitespace rule. No other DOM event emits text.
html_text_profile.outermost_blockquote_algorithm: when entering an outermost blockquote, flush the current nonempty body buffer after final whitespace normalization, suppress that outermost blockquote's own entry and exit LF events, route all accepted descendant events to one quote buffer, and emit that final nonempty quote buffer as one quote_block on exit; nested blockquotes use the ordinary block-boundary entry and exit LF events inside the same quote buffer; resume a new body buffer after the outermost exit
html_text_profile.line_feed_finalization: after DOM event emission and before block emission, replace HT and FF in text-node output with ASCII space, strip ASCII spaces immediately adjacent to LF, collapse each ASCII-space run to one, collapse each LF run to at most two, and trim leading or trailing ASCII space or LF; this operation is applied independently to each body quote and link-label buffer
html_text_profile.text_whitespace: in text nodes replace HT and FF with ASCII space; preserve parser-decoded scalars; emitted block boundaries and br/hr are LF; strip ASCII spaces adjacent to LF, collapse ASCII-space runs to one, collapse LF runs to at most two, and trim leading/trailing ASCII space or LF from each emitted block
html_text_profile.quote_segmentation: an outermost blockquote element at any depth flushes the current body buffer and emits one quote_block from its complete descendant inert text including nested blockquotes; leaving it starts a new body buffer; maximal nonempty text outside outermost blockquote boundaries emits body_block; empty blocks are discarded
html_text_profile.link_labels: for every a element in document order emit one link_label block from its descendant inert text using the same whitespace rule; discard an empty label and never read fetch canonicalize persist or digest href
html_text_profile.remote_behavior: no URL resolution fetch CSS image font media iframe object redirect or event execution occurs

steps_in_order: reject any account mailbox cloud locator version schema or source-ref binding mismatch without a network call
under G-MAIL refetch the primary immutable id through the bound account and exact selected-field contract
canonicalize transient content and require the full content digest plus prefix and suffix digest at the stored range
if all anchors match project primary_verified in memory and discard fetched content after the bounded operation
if the item resolves but anchors differ project changed freeze evidence-dependent automation and require review before reanchoring
if the primary does not resolve enumerate the complete bounded candidate universe exactly as defined by fallback_search_contract and verify every candidate with all three anchors
only a completed enumeration may classify zero one or many verified candidates; zero projects unavailable and more than one projects candidate_ambiguous
only one verified candidate from a completed enumeration may be offered as replacement evidence and requires explicit user confirmation before locator replacement
persist an approved locator replacement and new anchors only in one ADR-005 transaction after G-STATE and G-PRIV
resolution_state_machine.network_failures: throttling outage consent revocation and transient client failure project stale_or_unavailable status without destructive locator change

fallback_search_contract.candidate_universe: the union of messages already observed under the bound account in every currently authorized selected folder and configured history window; no unselected folder mailbox directory global search or newly requested permission is included
fallback_search_contract.enumeration_order: selected collections by unsigned collection_ref bytes, then each collection's opaque Graph paging order; nextLink remains opaque and every page must be consumed
fallback_search_contract.completion_marker: complete only after every selected collection reaches a terminal page within the fixed G-MAIL-validated page item byte and wall-clock caps and every candidate refetch and attachment-metadata sequence reaches its terminal response
fallback_search_contract.complete_classification: after complete enumeration and exact account source schema canonicalization and triple-anchor verification, zero verified candidates projects unavailable, one may be offered for explicit confirmation, and every one of two or more verified candidates is surfaced as candidate_ambiguous
fallback_search_contract.incomplete_classification: any throttle outage consent loss retry exhaustion page cap item cap byte cap time cap malformed response attachment cap or missing terminal page projects candidate_ambiguous with search_incomplete or safe unavailable/stale; it never projects zero or singleton and never offers or replaces a candidate
fallback_search_contract.candidate_storage: candidate identifiers selected fields canonical blocks and match details are transient only and are discarded after the bounded operation
fallback_search_contract.authority: fallback lookup and triple-anchor matches are candidate evidence only; they never establish copy lineage account identity delivery closure or automatic replacement
